title: Big Travel Plans
setting: A bright living room with a large world map on the wall.

characters.name: Sara
characters.look: Sara, a young woman with long brown hair and a green sweater

characters.name: Ivan
characters.look: Ivan, a young man with short black hair and a blue shirt

sentences.en: Sara and Ivan look at a big world map.
sentences.zh: 萨拉和伊万看着一张大大的世界地图。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara, a young woman with long brown hair and a green sweater and Ivan, a young man with short black hair and a blue shirt stand in front of a large world map on the living room wall.

sentences.en: Sara wants to visit Germany in Europe.
sentences.zh: 萨拉想去欧洲的德国游玩。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara, a young woman with long brown hair and a green sweater points at Germany in Europe on the world map.

sentences.en: Ivan shakes his head: Australia is very far.
sentences.zh: 伊万摇摇头：澳大利亚太远了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ivan, a young man with short black hair and a blue shirt shakes his head and points at Australia at the bottom of the map.

sentences.en: Mexico is to the south of America.
sentences.scene_prompt: A finger of Ivan, a young man with short black hair and a blue shirt moves down the map from America to Mexico.

sentences.en: Sara moves her finger from Canada to Asia.
sentences.zh: 萨拉的手指从加拿大移到亚洲。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara, a young woman with long brown hair and a green sweater moves her finger across the world map from Canada to Asia.

sentences.en: In Germany, trains leave from a big station.
sentences.zh: 在德国，火车从一个大车站出发。
sentences.scene_prompt: A fast train leaves a big busy station in Germany, a small flag of Germany on the map nearby.

sentences.en: Ivan also wants to ride a bicycle there.
sentences.zh: 伊万还想在那里骑自行车。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ivan, a young man with short black hair and a blue shirt happily imagines riding a bicycle through a green town.

sentences.en: Tomorrow, they drive their car to the airport.
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara, a young woman with long brown hair and a green sweater and Ivan, a young man with short black hair and a blue shirt put suitcases into their car, a plane in the sky above.
